rounds.text: The core of the bullish thesis rests on explosive, recent operational momentum that vastly outpaces historical baselines [E58]. Specifically, the business is demonstrating exceptional top-line acceleration, evidenced by year-over-year sales surging by 450% alongside positive quarter-over-quarter sales growth [E58, E60]. This powerful revenue expansion is further reinforced by screens explicitly identifying strong sales growth and accelerating earnings growth, signalling an inflection point in commercial traction [E59, E61]. Furthermore, the company's operational efficiency manages to outperform sector headwinds, registering a return on assets of -2.79% compared to a much worse sector benchmark of -8.52% [E7]. Market participants are beginning to recognise this shifting dynamic, with the stock trading strongly at 88% of its 52-week range [E4]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of -19.2% over the past five years [E55].
